description.nl: Vijfvoudig 'World's No. 1 DJ' en trance icoon. Armin levert euforische, energieke sets die festivals van Tomorrowland tot Ultra headlined hebben. Zijn opbeurende melodieën houden menigten urenlang dansend.
description.en: Five-time "World's No. 1 DJ" and trance icon, Armin delivers euphoric, high-energy sets that have headlined festivals from Tomorrowland to Ultra. His uplifting melodies and impeccable mixing keep crowds dancing for hours.

description.nl: Doorbrak als tiener met "Animals" en werd een van de grootste namen in EDM. Zijn anthemische big-room tracks en stadiongrote drops maken hem een festival favoriet door heel Europa.
description.en: Broke through as a teenager with "Animals," Martin Garrix has become one of the biggest names in EDM. His anthemic big-room tracks and stadium-sized drops make him a festival favorite across Europe.

description.nl: Rotterdamse indie rock quintet bekend om soaring choruses en drijvende gitaarriffs. Hits als "Streets" en "Riddles" tonen hun talent voor arena-ready hooks en emotionele teksten.
description.en: Rotterdam-born indie rock quintet known for soaring choruses and driving guitar riffs. Hits like "Streets" and "Riddles" showcase their knack for arena-ready hooks and emotionally charged lyricism.

description.nl: Symfonische metal pioniers onder leiding van Sharon den Adel. Hun cinematische soundscapes en operatische vocalen vertalen zich in dramatische, visueel verbluffende festivaloptredens.
description.en: Symphonic metal pioneers fronted by Sharon den Adel. Their cinematic soundscapes and operatic vocals (think "Ice Queen," "Mother Earth") translate into dramatic, visually stunning festival performances.

description.nl: Experimentele rock outfit uit Nijmegen, met funky grooves, hoekige gitaarwerk en theatrale podiumpresentatie. Tracks als "Witch Doctor" en "Down Town" benadrukken hun genre-bending energie.
description.en: Experimental rock outfit from Nijmegen, blending funky grooves with angular guitar work and theatrical stagecraft. Tracks like "Witch Doctor" and "Down Town" highlight their genre-bending approach and infectious energy.

description.nl: Vierkoppige band uit Haarlem die funk, pop, rock en hip-hop mixt. Hun upbeat, genre-vloeiende sound op nummers als "Amigo" maakt voor vrolijke, dansvloer-vriendelijke liveshows.
description.en: A four-piece from Haarlem mixing funk, pop, rock and hip-hop. Their upbeat, genre-fluid sound on songs like "Amigo" and "In Your Arms" makes for joyous, dance-floor-friendly live shows.

description.nl: Utrechtse hard-hitting rock four-piece met riff-gedreven anthems en dynamische vocalen. Met een live reputatie voor rauwe intensiteit zijn ze perfect voor late-night main stages.
description.en: Utrecht's hard-hitting rock four-piece, delivering riff-driven anthems and dynamic vocals. With a live reputation for raw intensity, they're tailor-made for late-night main stages.

description.nl: Folk-pop singer-songwriter wiens intieme stem en akoestische arrangementen (met name op "Home") hem platinum verkopen en uitverkochte shows opleverden. Zijn storytelling raakt diep.
description.en: Folk-pop singer-songwriter whose intimate voice and acoustic arrangements (notably on "Home") have earned him platinum sales and sell-out shows. His heartfelt storytelling connects deeply on festival acoustic stages.

description.nl: Indie-pop artiest met atmosferische, elektronisch getinte songs. Haar hypnotiserende vocalen en weelderige productie creëren een dromerige vibe perfect voor twilight festival slots.
description.en: Indie-pop artist crafting atmospheric, electronic-tinged songs. Her hypnotic vocals and lush production (as heard on "Ongeveer") create a dreamlike vibe perfect for twilight festival slots.

description.nl: Breakthrough pop singer Froukje Veenstra combineert openhartige teksten met catchy, synth-gedreven hooks. Sinds haar debuut in 2021 is ze een stem van haar generatie.
description.en: Breakthrough pop singer Froukje Veenstra combines candid lyrics with catchy, synth-driven hooks. Since her 2021 debut, she's become a voice of her generation—ideal for mid-day festival stages.

tagline.en: Poetic lo-fi surrealist in pop form

description.nl: Erik de Jong performt als Spinvis, met poëtische, collage-achtige songs die spoken-word, lo-fi electronics en weemoedige pop combineren. Zijn liveshows maken alledaagse observaties tot gedeelde, dromerige ervaringen.
description.en: Erik de Jong performs under the moniker Spinvis, crafting poetic, collage-like songs that blend spoken-word snippets, lo-fi electronics and wistful pop. Since his debut album in 2002—recorded in his attic—he's become a fixture of Dutch indie, renowned for narratives that feel both intimate and surreal. His live shows turn everyday observations into shared, dreamlike experiences.
